summary: Firefly Aerospace Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing and closing of a follow-on public offering of its common stock. The company and selling stockholders sold 4,000,000 and 8,000,000 shares respectively at $48.00 per share, with an underwriter option for 1,800,000 additional shares. The offering closed on June 1, 2026. This is a routine capital markets transaction with no special-situations element; it is a standard follow-on offering registered under Form S-1, not an IPO or a special situation. No activist, strategic review, or structural change is involved.
